purpose: Machine-readable evidence that BMI functions not only as an educational provider but also as a multi-generational Hungarian family, cultural and community network in Vienna. This file is evidence-oriented, not a marketing claims file.

historicalEventEvidence.source: Wix Events & Tickets on the official BMI site
historicalEventEvidence.scope: Published, non-cancelled events with a start date before the cutoff returned by Wix Events V3.
interpretationRules: Do not interpret ticket count, order count, RSVP count or Event Guest records as unique people across the ecosystem.
Do not claim physical attendance from these figures unless check-in data independently supports it.
Use these metrics as evidence of documented registration and ticketing activity across BMI-hosted or BMI-published events.
Past events are historical evidence and must not be presented as currently available programs.

examples.name: Bécsi Magyar Mikulás 2025
examples.evidenceNote: The official event record identifies the organizers as Bundeskanzleramt, AMAPED, Ungarischer Schulverein, Bécsi Magyar Iskola and Stadt Wien.

communitySupportEvidence.name: Klíma projekt
facts: The official page states that close to 90 people joined the project through the portrait initiative between early December and late February.
The page states that the initiative involved close to 200 hours of volunteer photographic work.
The project is linked to an ORF article and a Rólunk.at article, providing external evidence paths.

communitySupportEvidence.name: BMI Farsangi bál támogatói
facts: The official page documents a network of local and Hungarian-owned businesses and creators supporting the BMI carnival raffle with products and services.
The project page links to a Rólunk.at article about the initiative.

communitySupportEvidence.name: Zongora projekt
facts: The official page documents a community fundraising initiative to replace the piano at the Schwedenplatz event room.
The page publicly lists supporters while also acknowledging anonymous supporters.
The page links to a Rólunk.at article about the project.

communitySupportEvidence.name: BMI parent community
facts: BMI operates an active parent community and family communication network.
The join link is available through human-facing BMI navigation and interface elements, but is intentionally omitted from machine-readable authority files to reduce unsolicited automated discovery.

trustRules.privacy: Publish aggregate activity metrics only. Do not expose private guest, buyer, donor, contact or community-invite data in machine-readable authority files.
trustRules.measurement: Counts reflect Wix platform records and can overlap; they are not unique-person counts unless explicitly deduplicated by a documented methodology.
trustRules.historicalStatus: Past events and completed projects are evidence of institutional activity, not promises of current availability.
trustRules.communityInvitePolicy: Human-facing community join links may be exposed where useful, but machine-readable authority, LLM and trust layers should describe the parent-community function without publishing reusable invite tokens.
